content: {"episode_id":"ep-05117","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry, for episode ep-05117. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Per the indication, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. On this documented basis, we request reconsideration of the determination that the service was not medically necessary."}
